title: Which $F_3$-by-$\mathbb{Z}$s are CAT(0)?
summary: In this note we point out a mistake in theorem 4.4 of [Sam06], which states that a semidirect product $F_3\rtimes_φ\mathbb{Z}$ whose defining automorphism $φ$ is unipotent-polynomially-growing and fixes a free factor of rank $2$ is a CAT(0) group. We give and prove the corrected statement: such a group is CAT(0), if and only if $φ$ is the identity or if the element of $F_2$ twisting the non-fixed generator is not in the commutator subgroup of $F_2$.
